errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the categories on the vertical axis are arranged in descending order of their percentage values. The chart shows no specific sorting order; for example, the category with the highest value (Корупция, 19%) is second from the bottom, while the one with the lowest value (Друго, 1%) is at the top.
